PluginData.Tooltip: See your ship's layout and spot damaged or missing blocks.
PluginData.Description:
See your ship's layout and spot damaged or missing blocks. Sit in a cockpit and type /mg ui to open display controls, saved profiles and blueprint import.
Use /mg capture to save a full-health reference and cockpit anchor in one step. Or import a blueprint, preview the alignment and accept it. Profiles persist locally across sessions; automatic matching tries to reconnect them when you return.
Yellow means damaged, orange means non-functional, and pulsing red means missing from the saved layout. Green marks additions, purple replacements, and gray unreadable data.
Station mode shows connector-docked grids and their matched profiles; it is off by default for each ship. Rotor/piston subgrids are excluded. Use /mg auto off to disable automatic matching; identical copies may need manual selection.
Prototype: feedback fixes and large-grid performance still need in-game validation. /marigold is an alias for /mg.
